title: Minimax Estimation of Counterfactual Total Variation under Rough Confounding
banked_reason: The promised sharp four-criterion frontier is replaced by nonmatching brackets with unresolved logarithms, no explicit r_n/h_n sequences, and no attained matching converses; the stated supporting results are a weaker kernel than the headline contribution.
gap_reasons: The promised sharp four-criterion frontier is replaced by nonmatching brackets with unresolved logarithms, no explicit r_n/h_n sequences, and no attained matching converses; the stated supporting results are a weaker kernel than the headline contribution.

The claimed sharp estimator and honest intervals are only an unresolved construction program, not an evaluable total procedure with public calibration, so the Stat headline currently lacks its required usable estimator-and-rate deliverable.
proof_attempt_summary: Attempted the sharp observational and randomized absolute-risk and finite-honest-length frontiers for a normalized continuous causal TV model. Derived observational n^(-1/3) lower and (log(en)/n)^(1/4) upper bounds plus nonmatching randomized logarithmic brackets; mathematical review and both cited-source checks passed. The contracted matching frontier, calibrated attaining sharp procedures, essential logarithms, and risk-length comparisons remain open, so independent D and main validity consults confirmed terminal kernel substitution; no Lean formalization was reached.
tldr: Counterfactual density differences can remain substantial when mean differences vanish. The focal object is their unsmoothed total variation under the supplied continuous benchmark with unknown Hölder assignment and Lipschitz outcome densities. The question asks for sharp original-record absolute-risk and finite-sample honest-length orders on the observational class and its fair-randomization subclass. Every logarithm is an output. The central difficulty is the composition of a nonsmooth marginal contrast with learned reciprocal assignment corrections, subject to exact conditional normalization and fixed outcome-frequency amplitudes. Complete pilot-averaged polynomial energy control is the route to a public observational risk certificate and finite-sample calibration of counterfactual total-variation uncertainty.
gap: Causal density-distance theory gives plug-in or margin-based inference, while Gaussian norm theory leaves a uniform-envelope lower-bound boundary. No opened result supplies the specified four sharp original-record criteria. The unrestricted growing categorical experiment of \texttt{stat\_marginaltv\_confounded\_frontier} neither supplies a normalized fixed-Lipschitz continuous converse nor controls the continuous selected-cell approximation needed for this target.
fill: A complete solution supplies computable attainment, public finite-sample honesty and same-class converses, then derives the observational precision price and the risk-to-length comparison. Complete energy control certifies the observational risk upper and, by public error inflation, a 90-percent honest connected-interval length upper at the risk scale; matching length sharpness requires its own converse.
